answer: Make every identity continuously prove it stores its own uniquely sealed replica of a shared archive. The seal is keyed to that identity, and sealed bytes look random, so a hundred personas cannot dedupe onto one copy. Random storage challenges roll in like the tide and must be answered from local disk within seconds. An honest agent keeps one willow-shaded lagoon of storage; a sybil farm must dig and fill a fresh lagoon for every fake, every epoch.
